items.caution: Protects against physical attacks, not all spell damage. Shares the potion cooldown.

items.name: Restorative Potion
items.detail: Use: Removes 1 magic, curse, poison or disease effect on you every 5 seconds for 30 seconds. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Recipe from the Badlands reagent quest chain, then craft with Elemental Earth and Goldthorn.
items.caution: Situational cleansing; shares the potion cooldown.

items.name: Living Action Potion
items.detail: Use: Makes you immune to Stun and Movement Impairing effects for the next 5 sec. Also removes existing Stun and Movement Impairing effects. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Recipe requires Zandalar Tribe reputation; late-game crafting rather than a routine leveling purchase.
items.caution: Unlike Free Action, removes existing effects. Shares the potion cooldown.
items.ingredients: Icecap (2), Mountain Silversage (2), Heart of the Wild (2), Crystal Vial

items.name: Purification Potion
items.detail: Use: Attempts to remove one Curse, one Disease and one Poison from the Imbiber. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: World-drop Alchemy recipe and high-level herbs.
items.caution: Situational; shares the potion cooldown.

items.name: Flask of Petrification
items.detail: Use: You turn to stone, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 1 min, but during that time you cannot attack, move or cast spells. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. (3 Sec Cooldown)
items.route: Rare dungeon recipe, expensive materials and an Alchemy Lab.
items.caution: Immobilizes you. Do not assume it resets combat or guarantees survival.
items.ingredients: Stonescale Oil (30), Mountain Silversage (10), Black Lotus , Crystal Vial

items.name: Anti-Venom
items.detail: Use: Target is cured of poisons up to level 25. (1 Min Cooldown)
items.route: First Aid: craft from venom sacs. Basic recipe is trained; Strong uses a dropped manual; Powerful requires an Argent Dawn Honored recipe.
items.caution: The poison-level cap is not your character level. Powerful Anti-Venom requires First Aid 300 to use.

items.name: Target Dummy
items.detail: Use: Drops a target dummy on the ground that attracts nearby monsters to attack it. Lasts for 15 seconds or until killed. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Engineering craft. Basic and Advanced recipes are trained; Masterwork uses a vendor schematic.
items.caution: Engineering required to use. Can die before its duration ends. Shares a cooldown with Healthstones and Felwood healing plants.
items.ingredients: Copper Modulator , Handful of Copper Bolts (2), Bronze Bar , Wool Cloth

items.name: Minor Healthstone
items.detail: Use: Instantly restores 100 life. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Warlocks create these with a Soul Shard once the spell rank is trained. Other classes can receive one through trade.
items.caution: Shown at the Warlock creation level, not the lower item use level. Self Found characters cannot receive one from another player. Shares a cooldown with target dummies and Felwood healing plants. Base untalented healing shown; Improved Healthstone can increase it.

items.name: Thistle Tea
items.detail: Use: Instantly restores 100 energy. (5 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Rogue recipe: class quest reward, or the rogue-only recipe sold by Smudge Thunderwood at Ravenholdt. Cooking 60; Swiftthistle and water.
items.caution: Rogue only. The item use level is lower than normal access to its recipe.

items.name: Flash Powder
items.route: Buy from a poison / reagent vendor.
items.caution: Carry once Vanish is trained at level 22. A reagent, not a usable escape item by itself.

items.name: Blinding Powder
items.route: Rogues make it from Fadeleaf using their poison skill; also found in pickpocketed junkboxes.
items.caution: Carry once Blind is trained at level 34. A reagent, not a usable crowd-control item by itself.

items.name: Really Sticky Glue
items.detail: Use: Renders a target unable to move for 10 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Durotar: A Solvent Spirit rewards a finite supply. Usually a Horde leveling-route reward.
items.caution: Binds on pickup; cannot be replenished from the same completed quest.

items.name: Slumber Sand
items.detail: Use: Puts the enemy target to sleep for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only one target can be asleep at a time. (1 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Tirisfal Glades: A New Plague (quest 368) rewards a finite supply.
items.caution: Horde quest; binds on pickup. Damage breaks the sleep.

items.name: Light of Elune
items.detail: Use: Grants immunity from all damage and spells for 10 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Ashenvale: Mage Summoner rewards this item. The quest minimum is 20; its target is higher level.
items.caution: Alliance quest; binds on pickup, single use. Save deliberately; no repeatable supply.

items.name: Magic Dust
items.detail: Use: Puts the enemy target to sleep for up to 30 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only one target can be asleep at a time. (1 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Drops from Dust Devils in Westfall. They are level 18–19, above the item use level.
items.caution: An optional farm, not a dependable vendor supply. Damage breaks the sleep.

items.name: Jungle Remedy
items.detail: Use: Cures diseases and neutralizes poisons. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Drops from Kurzen humanoids in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
items.caution: The farming area is substantially higher level than the item requirement. Avoid a risky farm just to fill this list.

items.name: Whipper Root Tuber
items.detail: Use: Restores 700 to 900 health. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Cleanse Whipper Roots in Felwood using Cenarion Plant Salves after the Cleansing Felwood quest.
items.caution: Item use level 45 does not grant quest access. Shares a cooldown with Healthstones and target dummies.

items.name: Night Dragon's Breath
items.detail: Use: Restores 394 to 456 mana and 394 to 456 health. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Cleanse Night Dragons in Felwood using Cenarion Plant Salves after the Cleansing Felwood quest.
items.caution: Item use level 45 does not grant quest access. Shares a cooldown with Healthstones, Whipper Roots and target dummies.

items.name: Mana Agate
items.detail: Use: Restores 375 to 425 mana. (2 Min Cooldown)
items.route: Conjure your own gem with the trained Mage spell before leaving safety. No farmed reagent is needed.
items.caution: Uses the mana-gem cooldown, shared with target dummies and Healthstones. Conjured items disappear after an extended logout.

items.name: Light Feather
items.route: Collect from birds and other feather-dropping creatures, or buy through trade where allowed.
items.caution: Carry once the spell is trained; the feather does nothing by itself. Plan safe descents and allow for the spell duration.
